nom: ROUND LAB Pine Calming Cica Cream

avis.texte: This product makes my skin glow and immediately tames my issues with redness. It's a near perfect product if you also struggle with redness. Try it now!

When purchasing, I misunderstood the purpose of the item and the amount as I thought it was an everyday moisturizer. After regular use, I learned that it is great for when your skin starts to become a bit irritated. A little also goes a long way.

I'm really impressed with this cream! It hydrates my skin beautifully and feels comfortable all day. It works perfectly for my sensitive skin—no irritation at all. I also love that it's completely odorless, which makes it so pleasant to use. Plus, the packaging design is sleek and stylish, adding a nice touch to my skincare routine.
It's light and doesn't seem to make my face more itchy than it already is.

This moisturizer is so, so soft! You don't need much. It comes out feeling like water, dries quickly, and is only sliiightly tacky - but that goes away fast. You're left with the softest moisturized skin. It also helps to reduce the redness and irritation I get from washing my face. 10/10 product! My only wish is that it came in larger sizes.
I got this product to help with redness, itchiness and seemingly rash on my face. It seems so far to be helping to calm it.
I'm really feeling the benefits after a month of consistent use. So soothing. Helping calm my redness/rashes a lot.
I put this on at night and my skin felt silky even the next morning

This product gave me the WORST acne of my life; even worse than my cystic hormonal acne. I switched over my skin care routine (slowly) to using Round Lab after seeing this advertised all over. At first I assumed my skin must be purging with how awful the acne was, but 6 weeks and two periods later my skin looks disgusting. All this did was keep me from wanting to go to social events or take pictures for 6+ weeks (not to mention I'm now spending hundreds to fix this). I do NOT recommend for any type of acne prone skin.
My skin absorbed the product incredibly fast. It left my skin feeling refreshed and hydrated without any greasy sensation or layer. I have extremely oily sensitive skin. Worked wonderful for me.
This moisturizer absorbs incredibly fast, leaves the skin refreshed and hydrated without feeling greasy. I have extremely oily skin.
Very easy to apply. The creme does not leave a sticky finish. does not feel heavy on skin
This helped me with redness around my skin and felt very gentle and soothing. It doesn't irritate and feels lightweight. Would buy it again.

I use this cream every day together with the same serum and my skin feels very comfortable. I have sensitive skin that tends to redden very quickly, especially with strongly perfumed products, but this product has done me a lot of good. It doesn't have a strong scent and feels very good on the skin

I have the pine cleanser, toner, ampoule, and cream. I wasn't sure how much of a difference they were making until I missed a night of skincare and my redness returned with full force by the morning. I will live and die with this product on my face.
Excellent moisturizer in building the skin barrier. It is cool and gentle on the skin. I love it very much, but unfortunately its quantity is small
My mom loved it and said it felt really nice on her skin when she used it!
Very mild cream and any normal moisturiser Calm well my skin It doesn't irritate nor sticky finish
Love it, I have very sensitive skin and this cream helped me a lot, and my skin looks nice

This cream is so unique! I've never seen a cream absorb so quickly! It's definitely a must have for normal/oily skin types. I have a dry skin myself so it doesn't cover my need for hydration/moisture. But on hot humid summer days where I know I'll be sweaty I'll use this one because it's super lightweight and still enough.

I like how lightweight it is. I do wish it was a bigger size. It isn't enough to pair with my acne medication, but overall I think it is a great product. Especially if your skin isn't especially dry or acne-prone.

avis.titre: If your skin gets irritated easily you need this to calm it
avis.texte: If your skin gets irritated easily you need this to calm it down !! My skin is always irritated and dry and this has been a lifesaver! If you're in a colder/dryer climate I would recommend using a lightweight moisturizer with it as well. I can use it as a moisturizer by itself in the summer but any other month it wouldn't be moisturizing enough. If you have oily skin you might be able to pull it off though !!
easy to use. Perfect for a daily day cream for whom doesn't like a heavy cream or lotion.

I bought this thinking my skincare routine needed a calming moisturizer. My skin is prone to breakouts and it might need some extra help that this moisturizer is not providing. I think it works great at getting rid of redness but my blemish prone skin needs something different.
I wear makeup everyday and this cream does not pill and is a good base for my skin
I love everything about this product but the size. Very gentle on the skin.

avis.titre: This face cream is really soothing
avis.texte: This face cream is really soothing and helps to control the oil on my face while moisturizing it at the same time! Very happy with this face cream!

avis.titre: This is the second time I'm buying this
avis.texte: This is the second time I'm buying this, I really love ROUND LAB products as they use natural ingredients in their skin care product lines. This cream is light weight and easy to apply and is hydrating without feeling too heavy or sticky. When my skin feels a little sensitive or itchy, I will use this cream and I think it helps to soothe it a little. I took out 1 star because of the scent, while the scent is not very strong and I don't really think it is bad, it just takes a little while to get used to the cica scent.

avis.titre: It is incredibly moisturizing and gives an amazing hydrating
avis.texte: It is incredibly moisturizing and gives an amazing hydrating glow! I RECCOMEND IT
Great nighttime moisturizer. I pair it with the same ampoule. Gives a smooth peeling effect for my sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Very soothing, feels cold on the skin.
avis.texte: Very soothing, feels cold on the skin. A little goes a long way.

avis.titre: I wanted to try a different cream, especially with the ingre
avis.texte: I wanted to try a different cream, especially with the ingredient of Cica. It not thick or thin, I feel the consistency is perfect, for anyone that have combo/sensitive skin I totally recommend this product! This product reduce my redness and calms my skin very well, It also adds a very nice glow to the skin!!

This moisturizer is AMAZING. It comes in a similar packaging like the famous birch sunscreen and has a gel like consistency but it does not feel like a gel on the skin, more like a mixture of a cream and gel. Very lightweight but nourishing. Perfect for AM use, especially during summer or when you apply SPF on top. It is not irritating and perfect for sensitive and acne prone skin. Not sticky or tacky. Sinks into your skin within seconds and doesn't leave a shine or looks greasy. I will definitely repurchase it.

avis.titre: It's not as moisturizing as the Birch one I would say but st
avis.texte: It's not as moisturizing as the Birch one I would say but still pretty good!

avis.titre: This cream helps your skin gentle, but little bit dry for me
avis.texte: This cream helps your skin gentle, but little bit dry for me but still I really like it!
This moisturizer is really nice! I really think its been helping with my redness and I enjoy that I can layer on a thicker moisturizer on top of this one.

I have very dry, acne prone skin and while this isn't moisturizing enough to pair with my acne meds and winter weather, it doesn't irritate my skin and I think will work well in during the warmer months. Wears well under makeup, isn't greasy and has a nice creamy texture. Gave this to my younger brother and he loves it, his skin isn't as dry as mine during winter, he's now using it daily. He also has acne prone skin (not as bad as mine) and thinks it's helping it stay clear and helps prevent build up and blackheads. LOVE that it doesn't have any fragrance in it!
This is a nice lightweight feeling moisturizer. Settles nicely into the skin. Bought this because I have rosacea.
This is a nice moisturizer, it doesnt feel greasy and it has no fragrance which is a plus! Ive noticed the little redness I have on the sides of my nose has gone down, 100% recommended!

avis.titre: Great for Dry Acne Prone Skin
avis.texte: This was recommended to me by one of the employee in sukoshi at square one. It helped calm the redness on my skin and hydrate it very well ??

avis.titre: My favorite moisturizer for the summer
avis.texte: My favorite moisturizer for the summer. It hydrates my skin without being heavy and oily. Its a lightweight cream. I think its more of a gel lotion than a cream. Its perfect for the summer, but Ill probably not use this during the winter. If you live in colder areas, this might be too light for you. Consider your skin type and environment before purchasing.
Excellent cream! Very soothing and easy to apply. You can always trust round lab

avis.titre: This product have made my skin perfect
avis.texte: This product have made my skin perfect and not have any itchiness, will buy again.
